sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索尔金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the New York Times.
sentences.zh: 我负责《纽约时报》每日时事通讯 DealBook 的商业与政策报道。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市 DealBook 峰会的现场采访商界、政界和文化界最具影响力的领袖，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine Lagarde, Zilran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯蒂娜·拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼以及许多其他人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 你可以观看其中一些毫无防备、未经滤镜的实时对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 我们将于11月18日在 nytimes.com 上直播精选采访，供任何人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果你还不是订阅者，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容的一个月免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 我希望你能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 你不会想错过的。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 来自《纽约时报》，我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这里是《每日新闻》。

sentences.en: Today.
sentences.zh: 今天。

sentences.en: A cooperative relationship with China has been a pillar of the United States foreign policy for more than half a century.
sentences.zh: 与中国的合作关系半个多世纪以来一直是美国外交政策的支柱之一。

sentences.en: Edward Wong on why the Trump administration believes it's time for a change.
sentences.zh: 爱德华·黄将为您讲述为什么特朗普政府认为现在是做出改变的时候了。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, July 29th.
sentences.zh: 今天是7月29日，星期三。

sentences.en: Edward, can you tell me what happened in Houston last week?
sentences.zh: 爱德华，能告诉我上周休斯敦发生了什么吗？

sentences.en: Sure.
sentences.zh: 当然。

sentences.en: We first got a tip that something was up with the Chinese consulate in Houston around
sentences.zh: 我们最早得到的风声是关于休斯敦中国领事馆在大约

sentences.en: Tuesday afternoon or so, that the Chinese ambassador to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 周二下午左右出事了，中国驻美大使

sentences.en: had been told by American officials that he had three days to shut down the consulate and that the employees there had 30 days to then leave the country.
sentences.zh: 被美国官员告知，他有三天时间关闭领事馆，那里的员工随后有30天的时间离开这个国家。

sentences.en: And a colleague and I started chasing this tip, but we couldn't quite nail it down to publish a story.
sentences.zh: 我和一位同事开始追踪这条线索，但我们没能完全确认以发表报道。

sentences.en: Right now at 10, breaking news, Houston firefighters and police responding to the Chinese consulate in Montrose after reports of a fire.
sentences.zh: 现在是10点，突发新闻，在接到火灾报告后，休斯敦消防员和警察赶往蒙特罗斯的中国领事馆。

sentences.en: Crews were called to the building of Montrose in here around 8.20.
sentences.zh: 救援人员在大约8点20分被叫到蒙特罗斯的这座建筑。

sentences.en: In the evening, I started seeing these videos of people burning things in metal barrels, in open metal barrels.
sentences.zh: 到了晚上，我开始看到这些视频，人们在金属桶里，在露天的金属桶里烧东西。

sentences.en: And there was video of fire trucks and police cars surrounding the consulate with their lights on.
sentences.zh: 视频显示消防车和警车亮着灯包围了领事馆。

sentences.en: So it's quite a dramatic scene.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当戏剧性的场景。

sentences.en: And local media were reporting that documents appeared to be being burned in the courtyard of that building.
sentences.zh: 当地媒体报道称，该建筑庭院内似乎正在焚烧文件。

sentences.en: You know, for people in the national security world and the foreign policy world, when you
sentences.zh: 你知道，对于国家安全界和外交政策界的人来说，当你

sentences.en: see people burning lots of documents or papers at a diplomatic mission, the assumption is that they're about to clear out of the mission.
sentences.zh: 看到人们在外交机构焚烧大量文件或纸张时，大家的推测是他们正准备撤离该机构。

sentences.en: So when I saw those videos, I realized that the tip we had gotten that the Chinese ambassador had been told to shut down the Houston consulate within three days was indeed true.
sentences.zh: 所以当我看到那些视频时，我意识到我们得到的关于中国大使被告知在三天内关闭休斯敦领事馆的线索确实是真的。

sentences.en: On July the 21st, the U.S.
sentences.zh: 7月21日，美国

sentences.en: abruptly asked China to close its consulate in Houston.
sentences.zh: 突然要求中国关闭其驻休斯敦领事馆。

sentences.en: And within hours, the Chinese foreign ministry confirmed that in Beijing.
sentences.zh: 几小时内，中国外交部在北京对此予以证实。

sentences.en: We urge the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们敦促美方

sentences.en: to reverse this incorrect decision immediately.
sentences.zh: 立即撤销这一错误决定。

sentences.en: Otherwise, China will definitely take necessary legitimate actions.
sentences.zh: 否则，中方必将采取必要正当行动。

sentences.en: And why would the U.S.
sentences.zh: 为什么美国

sentences.en: take this pretty significant move of kicking these Chinese diplomats out of this consulate in Texas?
sentences.zh: 要采取这种把这些中国外交官赶出得克萨斯州领事馆的重大举措？

sentences.en: Officially, people in the American government told us that they targeted the Houston consulate because it was a hub of economic espionage and trade secrets espionage in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 官方层面，美国政府内部人士告诉我们，他们针对休斯敦领事馆是因为它是美国经济间谍活动和商业机密间谍活动的枢纽。

sentences.en: But American officials haven't given us detailed evidence on the activities undertaken by the
sentences.zh: 但美国官员并没有向我们提供中国外交官所从事活动的详细证据。

sentences.en: Chinese diplomats.
sentences.zh: 中国外交官。

sentences.en: And it's not clear to us how much farther these activities go beyond the types of covert or
sentences.zh: 而且我们并不清楚这些活动在多大程度上超出了

sentences.en: espionage activities that take place at missions around the world, including ones run by Americans.
sentences.zh: 世界各地机构中发生的隐蔽或间谍活动类型，包括美国人运营的机构。

sentences.en: But in the bigger picture, a main goal of some American officials in the Trump administration
sentences.zh: 但从宏观来看，特朗普政府中一些美国官员的主要目标

sentences.en: is to unwind a range of diplomatic and economic ties that have built up between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 是解除美中之间几十年来建立的一系列外交和经济联系，

sentences.en: and China over the decades, ever since President Nixon started the opening of China back in 1971.
sentences.zh: 自1971年尼克松总统开启对华接触以来一直如此。

sentences.en: So there's a version of this where the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以有一种说法是，美国

sentences.en: was looking for a reason to unwind this relationship, and espionage, real or not, was that reason.
sentences.zh: 一直在寻找解除这种关系的理由，而间谍活动，无论真假，就是那个理由。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And why would the Trump administration want to unwind its relationship with China?
sentences.zh: 特朗普政府为什么想要解除与中国的关系？

sentences.en: I mean, it's our single biggest trading partner.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，这是我们最大的单一贸易伙伴。

sentences.en: It's a global superpower.
sentences.zh: 这是一个全球超级大国。

sentences.en: It's a nuclear power.
sentences.zh: 这是一个核大国。

sentences.en: So that's a pretty significant decision.
sentences.zh: 所以这是一个相当重大的决定。

sentences.en: It is significant.
sentences.zh: 确实重大。

sentences.en: And there are some senior officials in the administration who are against this.
sentences.zh: 政府内部有一些高级官员是反对这一点的。

sentences.en: Throughout the last three and a half years, we've seen, broadly speaking, two factions of advisers on China competing against each other for Trump's ear.
sentences.zh: 在过去的三年半里，我们看到，广义上讲，特朗普身边的两派对华顾问互相争夺他的信任。

sentences.en: And that helps explain some of the contradictory impulses and policies that we've seen coming out of the administration on China during this period.
sentences.zh: 这有助于解释我们在这一时期从政府听到的一些相互矛盾的冲动和政策。

sentences.en: What do you mean?
sentences.zh: 你是什么意思？

sentences.en: On one side, you had the ones wanting to confront China, in part over trade and also in part over national security matters.
sentences.zh: 一方面，有一些人想要对抗中国，部分是因为贸易，部分也因为国家安全问题。

sentences.en: You had Peter Navarro, who's a White House trade advisor.
sentences.zh: 你有白宫贸易顾问彼得·纳瓦罗。

sentences.en: How do you work with a country that lies through its teeth?
sentences.zh: 你怎么和一个满嘴谎言的国家合作？

sentences.en: Who wrote a book called Death by China.
sentences.zh: 他写过一本书叫《致命中国》。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And then you also had Secretary of State Mike Pompeo.
sentences.zh: 然后你还有国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥。

sentences.en: They very much want to undermine our Western values, all the things that we hold most dear.
sentences.zh: 他们非常想要破坏我们的西方价值观，破坏我们最珍视的一切。

sentences.en: And those people saw China as a threat to America.
sentences.zh: 这些人将中国视为对美国的威胁。

sentences.en: And then on the more cooperative side, you have, for example, Treasury Secretary Steve Mnuchin.
sentences.zh: 然后在比较倾向合作的一边，例如，有财政部长史蒂芬·姆努钦。

sentences.en: We need to work together to maximize the benefit for both sides.
sentences.zh: 我们需要共同努力，为双方争取最大利益。

sentences.en: People who still clung to the classic notions of free trade and thought that the traditional
sentences.zh: 那些仍然执着于自由贸易传统观念、认为与中国的传统

sentences.en: relationship with China was a stabilizing force in the world and that this had helped American companies get wealthy over the years as well as had benefited American consumers.
sentences.zh: 关系是世界稳定力量的人，认为这不仅帮助美国公司多年来变得富有，也使美国消费者受益。

sentences.en: And Edward, when it comes to those who want to confront China, when it comes to the
sentences.zh: 爱德华，说到那些想要对抗中国的人，说到

sentences.en: Peter Navarro's and the Mike Pompeo's, what is their case for why China is such a threat to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 彼得·纳瓦罗和迈克·蓬佩奥之流，他们认为中国对美国构成如此大的威胁并应该被遏制的理由是什么？

sentences.en: and should be reined in?
sentences.zh: 应该被遏制？

sentences.en: Well, they argue that China presents a range of strategic threats to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，他们认为中国对美国构成了多方面的战略威胁。

sentences.en: For example, they say that China's attempts to export its 5G technology, its next generation communications technology around the world presents a security threat.
sentences.zh: 例如，他们说中国试图将其5G技术、其下一代通信技术出口到世界各地，构成了安全威胁。

sentences.en: They say that China's recent military expansionism in the South China Sea and its vast maritime
sentences.zh: 他们说中国最近在南海的军事扩张主义及其在该海域的巨大海洋

sentences.en: claims in that sea are also a security threat and they would impede American military dominance in the Asia-Pacific.
sentences.zh: 主张也是一种安全威胁，并且它们会阻碍美国在亚太地区的军事主导地位。

sentences.en: They point to attempts at economic espionage by China and a vast range of cyber attacks
sentences.zh: 他们指出中国企图进行经济间谍活动以及针对美国政府

sentences.en: that have targeted the American government and other important institutions around the world.
sentences.zh: 和世界各地其他重要机构的大量网络攻击。

sentences.en: Am I right to think that from the start of this presidency, the confrontation camp more or less prevailed?
sentences.zh: 我这样想对吗，从这届总统任期开始，对抗派就或多或少占据了上风？

sentences.en: Well, it's complicated.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这很复杂。

sentences.en: The first big blow to the U.S.-China relationship under the Trump administration was in mid-2018.
sentences.zh: 在特朗普政府领导下，美中关系受到的第一次重大打击是在2018年中期。

sentences.en: We're going to have some incredible things.
sentences.zh: 我们将迎来一些了不起的成果。

sentences.en: We're just announcing very big tariffs today on China because China has been...
sentences.zh: 我们今天刚刚宣布对中国征收非常大的关税，因为中国一直……

sentences.en: When President Trump started putting tariffs on billions of dollars of goods made in China,
sentences.zh: 当特朗普总统开始对价值数十亿美元的中国制造商品加征关税时，

sentences.en: China retaliated by doing the same on American goods.
sentences.zh: 中国通过对美国商品采取同等措施进行了报复。

sentences.en: So here's what they would do.
sentences.zh: 所以他们会这样做。

sentences.en: They target farm products such as soybean cars, seafood...
sentences.zh: 他们将目标对准农产品，如大豆、汽车、海鲜……

sentences.en: And then just spiral downward from there.
sentences.zh: 然后从那里开始急剧螺旋式下降。

sentences.en: Medical equipment, energy products, that would start a little bit...
sentences.zh: 医疗设备、能源产品，这将开始……

sentences.en: As the U.S.-China trade war escalates, business leaders have been speaking up.
sentences.zh: 随着美中贸易战升级，商界领袖们纷纷发声。

sentences.en: FedEx CEO...
sentences.zh: 联邦快递首席执行官……

sentences.en: So the trade war had this huge impact on companies both in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以贸易战对美国境内

sentences.en: and outside of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 和境外公司的影响都非常巨大。

sentences.en: And it created a lot of instability in their thinking about how to do business.
sentences.zh: 这给他们如何开展业务的想法带来了极大的不稳定。

sentences.en: The escalating trade battle between the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美中之间不断升级的贸易战

sentences.en: and China is rocking investors around the world.
sentences.zh: 正在震动全球投资者。

sentences.en: It created a lot of instability in the stock markets, which Trump watches closely.
sentences.zh: 它给特朗普密切关注的股票市场带来了很大的不稳定。

sentences.en: And some farmers in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 美国的一些农民

sentences.en: say the disruption of normal trade with China has forced many of them to go bankrupt.
sentences.zh: 表示，与中国正常贸易的中断迫使他们中的许多人破产。

sentences.en: Important groups of voters who had supported Trump, for example, farmers in the Midwest, were starting to suffer.
sentences.zh: 一直支持特朗普的重要选民群体，例如中西部的农民，开始遭受痛苦。

sentences.en: I was a Trump voter.
sentences.zh: 我曾是特朗普的选民。

sentences.en: I voted for the president, certainly.
sentences.zh: 我当然投了总统的票。

sentences.en: But he certainly hasn't come through.
sentences.zh: 但他确实没有兑现承诺。

sentences.en: He's lost on trade.
sentences.zh: 他在贸易上输了。

sentences.en: He's lost on trade and certainly...
sentences.zh: 他在贸易上输了，而且当然……

sentences.en: They saw agricultural products like corn and soybeans piling up in the Midwest because China had imposed tariffs on their end to strike back at Trump.
sentences.zh: 他们看到中西部地区玉米和大豆等农产品堆积如山，因为中国实施了关税以回击特朗普。

sentences.en: So I won't be voting for the president again.
sentences.zh: 所以我不会再投总统的票了。

sentences.en: So Trump and some of his economic advisors, especially those who were preaching more cooperation in China, started to get nervous about these economic signs that they were seeing,
sentences.zh: 因此，特朗普和他的一些经济顾问，尤其是那些宣扬对华更多合作的人，开始对他们看到的这些经济迹象感到焦虑，

sentences.en: as well as about the anxieties of these Midwestern farmers and potential Trump voters there.
sentences.zh: 同时也对这些中西部农民和那里潜在的特朗普选民的焦虑感到担忧。

sentences.en: And so what do they do, these cooperation camp folks who are not happy with this trade war?
sentences.zh: 那么他们会怎么做，这些对这场贸易战不满的合作派人士？

sentences.en: Well, as they go through negotiations for a potential truce to the trade war,
sentences.zh: 嗯，在他们为贸易战潜在休战进行谈判的过程中，

sentences.en: President Trump talks with the presidency of China several times.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统与中国最高领导人进行了多次通话。

sentences.en: And they have these like sort of one-on-one conversations that Trump likes to do with leaders.
sentences.zh: 他们进行了那种特朗普喜欢与领导人进行的单独对话。

sentences.en: And in each of these, Trump sort of cozies up to see.
sentences.zh: 在每一次通话中，特朗普都有点向对方示好。

sentences.en: And it's clear he's willing to sort of brush aside a lot of sort of the most egregious behaviors of China in the pursuit of this trade deal.
sentences.zh: 很明显，为了达成这项贸易协议，他愿意把中国许多最令人发指的行为放在一边。

sentences.en: Like what?
sentences.zh: 比如什么？

sentences.en: In one conversation, according to John Bolton, the former national security advisor,
sentences.zh: 据前国家安全顾问约翰·博尔顿透露，在一次对话中，

sentences.en: Trump encouraged Xi to actually continue building internment camps for Muslims in the northwest of China and sort of signaled that this wasn't a big issue for him.
sentences.zh: 特朗普鼓励习继续在中国西北部为穆斯林建造拘留营，并暗示这不是什么大问题。

sentences.en: These are the Uyghurs.
sentences.zh: 这些是维吾尔人。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: These are the Uyghurs, exactly.
sentences.zh: 这些就是维吾尔人，完全正确。

sentences.en: The ones a million or more held over the recent years in internment camps.
sentences.zh: 近年来有上百万或更多人被关押在拘留营中的那些人。

sentences.en: And, for example, we've seen these during this period, these pro-democracy protests arise in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 例如，在此期间，我们看到香港爆发了这些争取民主的抗议活动。

sentences.en: And while Trump's national security aides are supportive of them,
sentences.zh: 虽然特朗普的国家安全助手支持他们，

sentences.en: Trump himself tells Xi privately in a phone call that Xi should just handle those in whatever way he wants to deal with those.
sentences.zh: 但特朗普本人在一次电话中私下对习说，习应该以自己想要处理的方式去处理那些事情。

sentences.en: And that Trump himself will not say anything about those.
sentences.zh: 而且特朗普本人不会对此发表任何言论。

sentences.en: And he'll tell his aides not to say anything vocally about those protests either.
sentences.zh: 他还会告诉他的助手们也不要大声对这些抗议活动发表任何言论。

sentences.en: So in this trade war that's supposed to represent confrontation with China, there's actually a fair amount of cooperation going on, most of it behind the scenes.
sentences.zh: 所以在本应代表对抗中国的这场贸易战中，实际上存在相当多的合作，其中大部分都在幕后进行。

sentences.en: Right, exactly.
sentences.zh: 没错，完全正确。

sentences.en: And ultimately, in December, they reach a tentative agreement, and then they sign that in January of this year.
sentences.zh: 最终，在12月，他们达成了初步协议，然后在今年1月签署了协议。

sentences.en: And I think that brought a big sense of relief to the people in the cooperation camp.
sentences.zh: 我认为这给合作派的人带来了一种巨大的解脱感。

sentences.en: I think they were relieved to see a sense of stability return to this key economic relationship.
sentences.zh: 我认为他们看到稳定感重回这一关键经贸关系时感到如释重负。

sentences.en: Now, the confrontation people in the White House and in other agencies were generally disappointed, I think, by the outcome of the deal.
sentences.zh: 现在，白宫和其他机构的对抗派对协议的结果普遍感到失望，我认为。

sentences.en: They felt that Trump had sidelined a lot of the hardline policies they had pushed for in the first half of the administration
sentences.zh: 他们觉得特朗普为了仅仅争取农业采购量的边际增长，

sentences.en: for the sake of just trying to get a marginal increase in agricultural purchases.
sentences.zh: 而将他们在政府前半期力推的许多强硬政策抛在了一边。

sentences.en: And also, there was a sense of outrage among some of them, and this was in John Bolton's recent book,
sentences.zh: 此外，他们中的一些人也感到愤怒，约翰·博尔顿最近的书里也提到了这一点，

sentences.en: that Trump was also aiming for this negotiate truce purely for re-election purposes,
sentences.zh: 即特朗普寻求这种谈判达成的休战纯粹是为了连任目的，

sentences.en: that he pleaded with she in a conversation that she should help him get re-elected, should help him win,
sentences.zh: 他在谈话中恳求习帮助他连任，帮助他获胜，

sentences.en: and that the best way to do this was to reach some sort of truce or deal in the trade war that he could then bring back to his constituents.
sentences.zh: 而做到这一点的最好方法就是在贸易战中达成某种休战或协议，然后他可以将其带回给选民。

sentences.en: And so certain national security people were outraged by the saying that Trump was focused purely on personal politics
sentences.zh: 因此，某些国家安全界人士对此感到愤怒，认为特朗普纯粹专注于个人政治，

sentences.en: and was not looking after the national security interests of the United States.
sentences.zh: 而没有照顾好美国的国家安全利益。

sentences.en: Edward, what you're describing so far, especially this trade deal, does not seem like a relationship that is about to be fundamentally unwound and blown up.
sentences.zh: 爱德华，你到目前为止所描述的，特别是这个贸易协议，看起来并不像一段即将被彻底解除和炸毁的关系。

sentences.en: So what happens to get us from that truce to now, into the shutdown of this consulate in Houston?
sentences.zh: 那么发生了什么才让我们从那种休战走到现在，走到关闭这个休斯敦领事馆的地步？

sentences.en: Well, what changes things is this pandemic that starts in central China and spreads across the globe.
sentences.zh: 嗯，改变局势的是这场始于中国中部并蔓延全球的大流行病。

sentences.en: That sets the two powers on a much more confrontational course.
sentences.zh: 这使两个大国走上了更具对抗性的道路。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Hey, I'm Benjamin Poulin.
sentences.zh: 嘿，我是本杰明·普兰。

sentences.en: And I'm Mark Ronson.
sentences.zh: 我是马克·荣森。

sentences.en: And welcome to The Reframers, a podcast that's all about the love of design and the culture that surrounds it.
sentences.zh: 欢迎收听《重塑者》，这是一档专注于设计之美及其周围文化的播客。

sentences.en: Even back when I was DJing in nightclubs in the era of vinyl, every night you took 300 of your most prized possessions to work with you
sentences.zh: 甚至在黑胶唱片时代我在夜店当DJ的时候，每天晚上你都会带着300件你最珍爱的藏品去工作，

sentences.en: and you turned a DJ booth into this, like, living pop-up museum of beautiful 50-year-old artifacts.
sentences.zh: 然后把DJ台变成这样一个充满活力的快闪博物馆，摆满了美丽的、有50年历史的工艺品。

sentences.en: Listen to The Reframers from Audemars Piguet now on your favorite podcast platforMs.
sentences.zh: 现在就在你喜爱的播客平台上收听来自爱彼的《重塑者》。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 已解锁？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to The Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道，你需要订阅《时报》才能阅读所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore The Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果你能免费体验《时报》一个月，且不需要输入信用卡呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download The New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你首次下载《纽约时报》应用时，你在应用中的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 有一个月的时间可以突破付费墙，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么内容。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to The New York Times, download The Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用，享受30天的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I spoke with President Xi.
sentences.zh: 我同习近平主席通了话。

sentences.en: We had a great talk.
sentences.zh: 我们进行了一次很好的交谈。

sentences.en: He's working very hard, I have to say.
sentences.zh: 不得不说，他工作非常努力。

sentences.en: He's working very, very hard.
sentences.zh: 他工作非常、非常努力。

sentences.en: So in the first weeks after the virus started spreading around the globe, Trump was still praising Xi publicly.
sentences.zh: 因此，在病毒开始在全球传播的最初几周里，特朗普仍然在公开赞扬习近平。

sentences.en: If you know anything about him, I think he'll be in pretty good shape.
sentences.zh: 如果你对他有所了解，我认为他的状态会相当不错。

sentences.en: They've had a rough patch.
sentences.zh: 他们经历了一段艰难时期。

sentences.en: And I think right now they have it.
sentences.zh: 而我认为他们现在正处于那种状态。

sentences.en: It looks like they're getting it under control more and more.
sentences.zh: 看起来他们对局势的控制越来越好。

sentences.en: This was in January and February, right after they had signed the trade agreement.
sentences.zh: 这是在1月和2月，就在他们签署贸易协议之后。

sentences.en: So Trump was still in this mode where he wanted intensely to preserve that negotiated truce.
sentences.zh: 所以特朗普当时仍然处于极力想要维护那个通过谈判达成的休战协议的状态。

sentences.en: But by the spring...
sentences.zh: 但到了春天……

sentences.en: We got hit by the virus that came from China.
sentences.zh: 我们遭到了来自中国的病毒的打击。

sentences.en: Trump was laying into China publicly for what had happened.
sentences.zh: 特朗普开始为所发生的事情公开严厉指责中国。

sentences.en: You know, the pandemic had spread into all corners of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 你知道，大流行已经蔓延到了美国的各个角落。

sentences.en: The economy was in shambles.
sentences.zh: 经济一团糟。

sentences.en: Trump was seeing his re-election chances starting to go down the drain.
sentences.zh: 特朗普看到自己连任的机会开始付诸东流。

sentences.en: And we continue our relentless effort to defeat the Chinese virus.
sentences.zh: 我们将继续坚持不懈地努力战胜中国病毒。

sentences.en: Why do you keep using this?
sentences.zh: 你为什么一直用这个词？

sentences.en: A lot of people say it's raciSt.
sentences.zh: 很多人说这是种族主义。

sentences.en: It's not racist at all.
sentences.zh: 一点也不是种族主义。

sentences.en: No, not at all.
sentences.zh: 不，完全不是。

sentences.en: It comes from China.
sentences.zh: 它来自中国。

sentences.en: That's why.
sentences.zh: 这就是原因。

sentences.en: It comes from China.
sentences.zh: 它来自中国。

sentences.en: And so his campaign strategists came up with this idea that they can try and shift the conversation to China rather than having people focus on Trump's failures on the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 因此，他的竞选战略家们想出了这样一个主意：他们可以试图将对话转移到中国身上，而不是让人们关注特朗普在应对大流行上的失败。

sentences.en: And that by blaming China for all of this, they could win back some of the votes that Trump's starting to lose.
sentences.zh: 并且通过将这一切归咎于中国，他们可以赢得一些特朗普开始失去的选票。

sentences.en: Some of his top advisors started speculating whether the virus might have started from a lab accident.
sentences.zh: 他的一些高级顾问开始推测病毒是否可能源于实验室事故。

sentences.en: I can tell you that there is a significant amount of evidence that this came from that laboratory in Wuhan.
sentences.zh: 我可以告诉你，有大量证据表明这源于武汉的那个实验室。

sentences.en: Even though there was no evidence for that.
sentences.zh: 尽管当时根本没有任何证据。

sentences.en: Have you seen anything at this point that gives you a high degree of confidence that the Wuhan Institute of Virology was the origin of this virus?
sentences.zh: 你现在有没有看到任何能让你高度确信武汉病毒研究所是该病毒源头的证据？

sentences.en: Yes, I have.
sentences.zh: 是的，我有。

sentences.en: Yes, I have.
sentences.zh: 是的，我有。

sentences.en: So you have this very concerted effort by Trump to really cast China as the person or the entity to blame for all of this.
sentences.zh: 所以你会发现，特朗普正在进行这种极其一致的努力，极力将中国塑造成应该为这一切承担责任的个人或实体。

sentences.en: China's cover-up of the Wuhan virus allowed the disease to spread all over the world, instigating a global pandemic.
sentences.zh: 中国对武汉病毒的掩盖导致该疾病在全世界蔓延，从而引发了全球大流行。

sentences.en: And where does the pandemic fit into the kind of now familiar outlines that you have described of the confrontation camp versus the cooperation camp?
sentences.zh: 那么大流行在你所描述的对抗阵营与合作阵营这种如今已为人熟悉的框架中处于什么位置？

sentences.en: I have to imagine it kind of challenges both.
sentences.zh: 我不得不猜想，这两种阵营都受到了挑战。

sentences.en: The pandemic really empowers the hawks in the administration to say, we really have to go after China.
sentences.zh: 大流行确实赋予了政府内部的强硬派权力，让他们得以宣称：我们真的必须对中国采取强硬行动。

sentences.en: Look at how their misgovernance, how their political system led us to this point, led America into an economic crisis that's been the worst since the Great Depression.
sentences.zh: 看看他们的治理不善，看看他们的政治体制是如何将我们带到这一步的，将美国带入了自大萧条以来最严重的经济危机。

sentences.en: And even the people in the cooperation camp are starting to change their minds a bit.
sentences.zh: 甚至连合作阵营的人也开始改变一点他们的想法了。

sentences.en: It's hard to tell the world that we should prioritize this trade agreement that just rests on some agriculture purchases when you've got this global crisis enveloping everything and when American citizens are anxious about their future.
sentences.zh: 当全球危机席卷一切、美国公民对自己的未来感到焦虑时，你很难去告诉世界，我们应该优先考虑那个仅仅依赖于一些农产品采购的贸易协议。

sentences.en: And how does China respond to these attacks from Trump and from his advisors?
sentences.zh: 中国又是如何回应来自特朗普及其顾问的这些攻击的呢？

sentences.en: So what we're hearing this spring is Chinese officials denouncing the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以我们在这个春天听到的是，中国官员谴责美国

sentences.en: for all of these attacks.
sentences.zh: 发起的这一切攻击。

sentences.en: And they also point out that the Chinese system actually has handled the virus a lot better than the American system.
sentences.zh: 他们还指出，实际上中国的体制处理病毒的方式比美国的体制要好得多。

sentences.en: They say, even though there might have been this outbreak in central China, look at how we controlled it through the measures we took.
sentences.zh: 他们说，尽管中国中部可能曾爆发过疫情，但看看我们通过采取的措施是如何控制住它的。

sentences.en: And look at how the virus is running rampant in the U.S.
sentences.zh: 再看看病毒在美国是如何肆虐的。

sentences.en: And China also then starts to try and send out aid to other countries.
sentences.zh: 于是中国也开始尝试向其他国家提供援助。

sentences.en: It starts sending shipments of, for example, medical supplies, medical equipment, face masks to other countries around the world and even to parts of the U.S.
sentences.zh: 它开始向世界各地甚至美国的部分地区运送物资，例如医疗用品、医疗设备、口罩，

sentences.en: to try and sort of mask over its own responsibility for how the outbreak began in its country.
sentences.zh: 以此来试图掩盖其对国内疫情爆发源头应负的责任。

sentences.en: So the relationship between the two powers was bad and then it got worse.
sentences.zh: 所以这两个大国之间的关系原本就很糟糕，然后变得更糟糕了。

sentences.en: And we have some breaking news coming in.
sentences.zh: 我们收到了一些突发新闻。

sentences.en: China's annual parliamentary meeting has been officially opened in Beijing and it's expected that national security legislation for Hong Kong will be discussed during the seven-day session.
sentences.zh: 中国全国人民代表大会已在北京正式开幕，预计在为期七天的会议期间将讨论香港国家安全立法问题。

sentences.en: In the late spring, Chinese officials start talking about this new national security law that they want to impose on Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 在春末，中国官员开始谈论他们希望强加给香港的这部新国家安全法。

sentences.en: Well, this piece of the news has set shockwaves across the city.
sentences.zh: 嗯，这条新闻在整个城市引发了巨大的震动。

sentences.en: It says Beijing will set up a new national security bureau in Hong Kong, supervised by the central government, to crack down on dissent in the city.
sentences.zh: 报道称，北京将在香港设立一个新的维护国家安全公署，由中央政府监督，以打击该市的异见人士。

sentences.en: The legislation has faced sharp criticism from governments all around the world and sparked new protests in Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 该立法遭到世界各地政府的强烈批评，并在香港引发了新一轮抗议活动。

sentences.en: And so this continues the downward spiral that U.S.-China relations have been on.
sentences.zh: 因此，这延续了美中关系一直在经历的螺旋式下滑。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And I'm imagining that that security law was especially upsetting to those who want confrontation with China.
sentences.zh: 我猜想，这项安全法对于那些想要与中国对抗的人来说尤其令人沮丧。

sentences.en: That seems to be exactly the kind of thing that they find so objectionable.
sentences.zh: 这似乎正是他们觉得如此令人反感的那类事情。

sentences.en: That's right.
sentences.zh: 正是如此。

sentences.en: As you recall, they were very upset at Trump for putting the Hong Kong issue on the back burner in his aim to try and reach some sort of trade truce with China.
sentences.zh: 正如你所记得的，他们对特朗普为了试图与中国达成某种贸易休战而将香港问题置于次要地位感到非常不满。

sentences.en: And now they were intent on pushing forward on policies and actions that would make the Communist Party pay a price not only for what they were doing in Hong Kong,
sentences.zh: 而现在，他们决心推进各项政策和行动，让共产党不仅为他们在香港的所作所为付出代价，

sentences.en: but for their actions in other parts of the world and for their role in the pandemic.
sentences.zh: 还要为他们在世界其他地方的行动以及他们在应对大流行中的角色付出代价。

sentences.en: So they started announcing a series of actions against China that really brought the relationship to a new low.
sentences.zh: 因此，他们开始宣布针对中国的一系列行动，将双边关系真正带入了一个新的低谷。

sentences.en: They said that Hong Kong was no longer an autonomous entity and that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，香港不再是一个自治实体，美国

sentences.en: would break off its special relationship with Hong Kong.
sentences.zh: 将终止与香港的特殊关系。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: They imposed visa restrictions on a category of students who were associated with military institutions in China.
sentences.zh: 他们对与中国军事机构有关联的一类学生实施了签证限制。

sentences.en: They said that these students could no longer come to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们表示，由于涉嫌潜在的经济间谍活动，这些学生将不能再来美国

sentences.en: to do research or study because of suspicions of potential economic espionage.
sentences.zh: 进行研究或学习。

sentences.en: They've even floated a proposal internally to block all 92 million members of the Communist Party from traveling to the U.S.
sentences.zh: 他们在内部甚至还提出了一项提案，旨在阻止共产党的全部92万名党员

sentences.en: as well as their family members, which could encompass hundreds of millions of people.
sentences.zh: 及其家属前往美国，这可能涉及数亿人。

sentences.en: It's really felt like a moment where the gloves have been taken off in this relationship and where the people in the administration who want to fundamentally reorient the relationship with China have the upper hand right now.
sentences.zh: 这真的让人感觉在这段关系中双方已经撕破了脸，而且政府内部那些希望从根本上重新定位对华关系的人现在占据了上风。

sentences.en: And is it possible that at the end of the day, what you're describing here and the events of the past couple of weeks, it's the right strategy for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 那么有没有可能，归根结底，你在这里所描述的内容以及过去几周发生的事件，对美国来说是正确的战略呢？

sentences.en: Because China is behaving in ways that fundamentally violate American values, especially in Hong Kong, especially with the Uyghurs.
sentences.zh: 因为中国的行为从根本上违背了美国的价值观，尤其是在香港问题上，尤其是在维吾尔族问题上。

sentences.en: And so no matter what motivates Donald Trump to begin confronting China, is that potentially a good thing for the United States?
sentences.zh: 因此，无论是什么促使唐纳德·特朗普开始对抗中国，这对于美国来说潜在地算是一件好事吗？

sentences.en: Well, the people who are supportive of the more confrontational approach say that this type of strategy on China is long overdue.
sentences.zh: 嗯，那些支持采取更具对抗性态度的人表示，这种针对中国的战略早就该实行了。

sentences.en: Now it's time to really push back against China on all these fronts, especially at a time when China hasn't overtaken the U.S.
sentences.zh: 现在是时候在所有这些战线上真正回击中国了，特别是现在中国尚未超越美国

sentences.en: yet as the world's largest economy and it's still a rising power.
sentences.zh: 成为世界最大经济体且仍然是一个崛起中的大国的时候。

sentences.en: And this is a moment when we have this opening to really reframe the conversation on China, not only U.S.,
sentences.zh: 而现在正是我们拥有这样一个契机来真正重新构架对华对话的时刻，不仅是对美国而言，

sentences.en: but globally and sort of rally countries to really confront China on a whole range of issues.
sentences.zh: 而且是在全球范围内，并号召各国在这一系列广泛的问题上真正与中国对抗。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So basically, this is our last chance.
sentences.zh: 所以基本上，这是我们最后的机会了。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: They see it as time running out.
sentences.zh: 他们认为这是时间不多了。

sentences.en: Then you've got people in the other camp who say, we don't know where this will end.
sentences.zh: 然后另一阵营的人则会说，我们不知道这会以什么结局收场。

sentences.en: This starts this downward spiral in relations that starts to erode all the diplomatic ties, economic ties,
sentences.zh: 这引发了关系的螺旋式下滑，开始侵蚀所有的外交纽带、经济纽带，

sentences.en: the people-to-people ties that have kept the relationship firm over the decades.
sentences.zh: 以及几十年来一直维持双边关系稳固的人文纽带。

sentences.en: A relationship that's an unlikely one.
sentences.zh: 一种不太可能维持的关系。

sentences.en: You've got this close relationship between a Western democracy and an authoritarian state.
sentences.zh: 你拥有的是一个西方民主国家与一个威权国家之间这种紧密的联系。

sentences.en: And somehow they've managed to avoid open conflict.
sentences.zh: 而不知何故，他们设法避免了公开冲突。

sentences.en: They've managed to avoid war.
sentences.zh: 他们设法避免了战争。

sentences.en: And where could we end up, where could the world end up if we start breaking off those ties now?
sentences.zh: 如果我们现在开始切断这些纽带，我们最终会走向何方，世界又会走向何方？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: It could end up in a pretty dangerous place.
sentences.zh: 这可能会以一个相当危险的局面收场。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: So I want to return to where we started this conversation, Edward, which is with the U.S.
sentences.zh: 所以我想回到我们这场对话开始的地方，爱德华，那就是美国

sentences.en: kicking China out of its consulate in Houston.
sentences.zh: 驱逐中国驻休斯敦总领事馆。

sentences.en: Because it very much seems like this is the capstone to this approach.
sentences.zh: 因为这非常像是这种方法的压轴之作。

sentences.en: And I wonder what the response has been from China and what that tells us about what this dynamic of confrontation is going to start to look like over the next coming months and maybe even years.
sentences.zh: 我想知道中国的反应是什么，这向我们传达了关于未来几个月甚至几年里这种对抗态势将会如何发展的信息是什么？

sentences.en: Well, last Friday we saw China announce that it was going to force the U.S.
sentences.zh: 嗯，上周五我们看到中国宣布将强迫美国

sentences.en: to shut down its consulate in Chengdu, which is the only diplomatic mission that the U.S.
sentences.zh: 关闭其驻成都总领事馆，这是美国

sentences.en: has in Western China.
sentences.zh: 在中国西部地区拥有的唯一外交使团。

sentences.en: It's a very critical mission for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 这对美国来说是一个至关重要的使团，

sentences.en: because it allows American officials to observe what's going on in the vast reaches of that part of the country, including in Tibet, which is a very important issue for the U.S.
sentences.zh: 因为它允许美国官员观察中国西部广袤地区正在发生的事情，包括西藏，这对美国来说是一个非常重要的问题。

sentences.en: Because the people in Beijing couched this as a reciprocal action.
sentences.zh: 因为北京方面将此定性为对等反制措施。

sentences.en: And some people still say that they could have taken a more escalatory step,
sentences.zh: 有些人仍然认为他们本可以采取更具升级性的举措，

sentences.en: but that they appear to be willing to hold back and see whether there might be some reset of the relationship if Trump loses the election in November.
sentences.zh: 但他们似乎愿意克制，看看如果特朗普在11月的大选中落败，双边关系是否还有可能出现某种重置。

sentences.en: But even if that were the case, I'm not sure that their orientation of the relationship would change.
sentences.zh: 但即使真是那样，我也不确定他们对双边关系的定位会发生改变。

sentences.en: There might be a temporary halt to the tit-for-tat cycle that we're seeing, but it feels like because of where the U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们正在看到的这种针锋相对的循环可能会暂时停止，但感觉由于美中两国目前在世界上所处的位置以及两国根深蒂固的意识形态体制，我们可能正走上一条长期对抗的道路。

sentences.en: and China are now in the world and the entrenched ideological systems in both countries, we might be on course for a long-term confrontation.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢大家。

sentences.en: Thank you all.
sentences.zh: 你可以从几天前国务卿迈克·蓬佩奥在尼克松图书馆发表的那篇非常黑暗的演讲中听到这一点。

sentences.en: And you could hear that a few days ago in this very dark speech that Secretary of State Mike Pompeo gave at the Nixon Library.
sentences.zh: 我们，世界爱好自由的国家，必须以更具创造性和更加坚定有力的方式促使中国做出改变，因为北京的行动威胁到了我们的人民和繁荣。

sentences.en: We, the freedom-loving nations of the world, must induce China to change in more creative and assertive ways because Beijing's actions threaten our people and our prosperity.
sentences.zh: 他勾勒出了与中国爆发潜在冷战的愿景，并表示中国是美国最具挑战性的敌人。

sentences.en: He laid out a vision of a potential cold war with China and said that China was the most challenging foe to the United States.
sentences.zh: 现在，心地善良的人们可以辩论，为什么自由国家在这么多年里允许这些坏事发生。

sentences.en: Now, people of good faith can debate why free nations allowed these bad things to happen for all these years.
sentences.zh: 也许我们对中国带有病毒性质的共产主义过于天真，或者在冷战胜利后盲目自满，

sentences.en: Perhaps we were naive about China's virulent strain of communism, or triumphalists after our victory in the Cold War,
sentences.zh: 又或者卑躬屈膝地充当资本主义的附庸，亦或是被北京关于和平崛起的言论所蒙蔽。

sentences.en: or cravenly capitalists or hoodwinked by Beijing's talk of a peaceful rise.
sentences.zh: 无论出于什么原因，无论出于什么原因，今天的中国在内部日益独裁，并且在对其他地方自由的敌意上变得更具侵略性。

sentences.en: Whatever the reason, whatever the reason, today China is increasingly authoritarian at home and more aggressive in its hostility to freedom everywhere else.
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统曾说过……

sentences.en: President Trump has said...
sentences.zh: 爱德华，非常感谢。

sentences.en: Edward, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢，迈克尔。

sentences.en: Thanks a lot, Michael.
sentences.zh: 很高兴能参加这个节目。

sentences.en: It's been great being on the show.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天需要了解的其他内容。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 巴尔先生，您可以开始了。

sentences.en: Mr. Barr, you may begin.
sentences.zh: 早上好。

sentences.en: Good morning.
sentences.zh: 主席先生，资深委员乔丹。

sentences.en: Mr. Chairman, Ranking Member Jordan.
sentences.zh: 我很高兴今天早晨能来到这里。

sentences.en: I'm pleased to be here this morning.
sentences.zh: 我谨代表司法部，向您的……表达敬意

sentences.en: On behalf of the Department of Justice, I want to pay my respects to your...
sentences.zh: 在2018年民主党掌控众议院以来他的首次国会听证会上，

sentences.en: During his first appearance before the House since Democrats took control in 2018,
sentences.zh: 司法部长比尔·巴尔就其对从俄罗斯调查到全国范围内的警务抗议等一切事务的应对方式，受到了接连不断的质询。

sentences.en: Attorney General Bill Barr was repeatedly challenged over his response to everything from the Russia investigation to nationwide protests over policing.
sentences.zh: 阁下，总统在选举中索取或接受外国援助，在任何情况下都是合适的吗？

sentences.en: Is it ever appropriate, sir, for the president to solicit or accept foreign assistance in an election?
sentences.zh: 这取决于是什么样的援助。

sentences.en: It depends what kind of assistance.
sentences.zh: 总统或总统候选人在其选举中接受或索取任何形式的外国援助，在任何情况下都是合适的吗？

sentences.en: Is it ever appropriate for the president or presidential candidate to accept or solicit foreign assistance of any kind in his or her election?
sentences.zh: 总统或总统候选人在选举中接受或索取任何形式的外国援助的权力，在任何情况下都是合适的吗？

sentences.en: No, it's not appropriate.
sentences.zh: 不，这并不合适。

sentences.en: Okay, okay.
sentences.zh: 好吧，好吧。

sentences.en: Sorry you had to struggle with that one, Mr. Attorney General.
sentences.zh: 很抱歉让您不得不应付这个，巴尔总检察长。

sentences.en: Now let's turn to...
sentences.zh: 现在让我们转向……

sentences.en: Several Democratic lawmakers, including Representative Pramila Jayapal of Washington State,
sentences.zh: 几位民主党议员，包括来自华盛顿州的众议员普拉米拉·贾亚帕尔，

sentences.en: demanded to know why Barr had deployed federal agents to Oregon to monitor Black Lives Matter protests, but not to Michigan,
sentences.zh: 要求知道为什么巴尔会部署联邦特工前往俄勒冈州监控“黑人的命也是命”抗议活动，却没有去密歇根州，

sentences.en: where conservatives protested a coronavirus lockdown order.
sentences.zh: 那里的保守派曾抗议新冠疫情封锁令。

sentences.en: There is a real discrepancy in how you react as the attorney general, the top cop in this country.
sentences.zh: 作为总检察长、这个国家的最高执法官，您的反应存在真正的差异。

sentences.en: When white men with swastikas storm a government building with guns, there is no need for the president to, quote,
sentences.zh: 当带着纳粹旗帜的白人男子手持枪支冲进政府大楼时，总统完全不需要，引用原话，

sentences.en: activate you because they're getting the president's personal agenda done.
sentences.zh: “动用”你们，因为他们在帮总统达成个人的政治议程。

sentences.en: But when black people and people of color protest police brutality, systemic racism, and the president's very own lack of response to those critical issues,
sentences.zh: 但是当黑人和有色人种抗议警察暴力执法、系统性种族主义以及总统对这些关键问题的不闻不问时，

sentences.en: then you forcibly remove them with armed federal officers, pepper bombs, because they are considered terrorists by the president.
sentences.zh: 你们就会用武装联邦官员和胡椒弹强行驱逐他们，因为他们被总统视作恐怖分子。

sentences.en: Did I get it right, Mr. Barr?
sentences.zh: 我没说错吧，巴尔先生？

sentences.en: I have responsibility for the federal government, and the White House is the seat of the...
sentences.zh: 我对联邦政府负有责任，而白宫是……的所在地

sentences.en: Mr. Barr, let me just make you clear.
sentences.zh: 巴尔先生，让我跟您把话说清楚。

sentences.en: And on Tuesday, the nation's second largest teachers union, the American Federation of Teachers,
sentences.zh: 周二，全美第二大教师工会——美国教师联合会，

sentences.en: announced that it would support members if they choose to go on strike over unsafe school reopenings.
sentences.zh: 宣布如果会员选择就学校重开不安全问题举行罢工，工会将予以支持。

sentences.en: The union said that strikes should be a last resort,
sentences.zh: 工会表示罢工应该是最后手段，

sentences.en: but the announcement gives local teachers greater leverage in negotiations over the kinds of protections that teachers should have in reopened schools.
sentences.zh: 但这一声明让当地教师在有关重新开放的学校中应具备何种保护措施的谈判中获得了更大的筹码。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这就是本期《每日秀》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Michael Barbaro.
sentences.zh: 我是迈克尔·巴巴罗。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一个被严格控制的机器一样运作。

sentences.en: Until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 直到今年夏天，选举迎来了大批自称改革派的人士。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 自那以后，该党陷入了一场激烈、混乱且有时令人兴奋的权斗之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro, with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在最新一期的《都市》播客中，我是主持人莎拉·凯尼格，为您讲述人们试图维持影响力却在过程中逐渐失控的故事。

sentences.zh: 《都市》。
